2.49.25
List.DataInstanceName
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The List.DataInstanceName element specifies the name to use for the data element of each
instance of this List in a data rendering. This element is optional. If this element is present, its value
MUST be a CLS-compliant identifier [UTR15]. If this element is not present, its value is interpreted
as "Item".
If a Grouping is specified for the list, the List.DataInstanceName element is ignored and the value
of Grouping.DataElementName MUST be used for the name of the data element instead.
Following is the parent element of the List.DataInstanceName element.
Parent elements
List
The following is the XML Schema definition of the List.DataInstanceName element.
 <xsd:element name="DataInstanceName" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
